title: FizzBuzz as an array
source: FizzBuzz — the canonical programmer screening task; returned as an array of strings so the result is exactly checkable.
signature: function fizzbuzz(n)  // n: integer -> string[] of length n
prompt: Write a JavaScript function `fizzbuzz(n)` that returns an array of n strings for the numbers 1 through n. For multiples of 3 use "Fizz", for multiples of 5 use "Buzz", for multiples of both use "FizzBuzz", otherwise the number as a string.
